about: Central's own answers to central.file-map.inspect for a world's Music folder registered as a folder scope (central-47, central-47b), captured with ctrl from fixture roots, never a person's ground. {home} is the world's home and {ground} its Central. 'unscoped' is the ground before Music is a scope; 'setup' is Music registered as Setup registers it (its exclusions; the register itself, Central's refusal of one on a revision that moved, and its refusal of one sent as the kernel client's default project `o-i` would send it, are answers with an 'action'); 'unexcluded' the same world with Music registered with none; 'silent' a Music holding no audio (its world is 'silent_world'); 'bounded' a Music whose walk Central's directory bound stops (its world is 'bounded_world', with 'archive' empty folders under Music/Archive). Each ground is read page by page at each limit in 'limits'. Answers with 'action' action.describe are Central's disclosure of central.file-map.scope-register: 'setup' this ctrl's, 'older' the older Central's ('older_ctrl'). A folder in 'links' is a symbolic link.
ctrl: ctrl built from Central a3704919 (#328) with central-47b applied (ctrl 0.1.0 (14adaa7a8fb3))
older_ctrl: the installed ctrl, a Central without folder scopes (ctrl 0.1.0 (2616940bbdc6)), asked only action.describe
